annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部关于修改《民用航空器事件调查规定》的决定
annotation.title_en: Decision of the Ministry of Transport on Amending the Provisions on Investigation of Civil Aircraft Incidents
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Transport Order No. 34 (2022) amending the civil aircraft incident investigation rules, renamed 'Technical Investigation Provisions', effective 1 December 2022. It covers investigation organisation, ICAO cooperation, confidentiality, report publication within 12 months and penalties. Unmanned aircraft are covered only in the accident definition.
key_provisions_or_claims: Renames the rule to Provisions on Technical Investigation of Civil Aircraft Incidents, effective 1 Dec 2022
Investigation aims solely to prevent recurrence, not to apportion blame or liability
Extends the accident definition to approved unmanned aircraft
Final reports on accidents and serious incidents must be published within 12 months
Requires safety recommendation replies within 30 days, with fines for failure to reply
